title: Rubato Full Monomial Support Beyond Two Rounds
summary: All possible monomials are computed to appear at the end of the second round; it remains unresolved whether this property holds for every number of rounds greater than two.

formal_statement.body: The polynomial representation of Rubato is computed to contain all possible monomials at the end of the second round, and the unresolved task is to determine whether this full monomial-support property holds for every number of rounds greater than two.

scope.domain: Structural analysis of the Rubato stream cipher's polynomial representation.
assumptions: the independence assumption used in the heuristic analysis
parameters: round count: the second round is the computed baseline, and the conjecture concerns every count greater than two
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the polynomial representation contains all possible monomials for every number of rounds greater than two.

citations.label: Rubato: Noisy Ciphers for Approximate Homomorphic Encryption

progress.summary: The source uses an independence assumption heuristically and reports a computation showing all possible monomials at the end of the second round. It then explicitly conjectures that this property holds for more than two rounds.
citation_labels: Jincheol Ha et al., Rubato: Noisy Ciphers for Approximate Homomorphic Encryption
